relevance.why: A 572-piece harness is the opposite of the thin-context advice Haji has liked; for a time-poor founder it is a rabbit hole. Individual pieces (security audit agent, context-tidy hook) might be worth cherry-picking.

implement_score.why: Do not install wholesale. If anything, skim the index for 2-3 hooks/skills (security scan, context hygiene) and port them. Numbers in the video and the card disagree, which signals hype.

gap.what: Adds the ECC harness repo, not in the liked set (which had GStack, Addy Osmani's agent-skills, Paperclip, 818 cybersecurity skills). Same genre as those, bigger and less curated.
